command.name: Bronze Fury
verbatim: Rounds 2, 4, 6, 8: Deal Physical Damage (Damage Rate: +30%) and Tactical Damage (Damage Rate: +60%) to 2 Enemies within adjacency.
Odd-numbered Rounds: 30% chance to apply Protect to 1 other Ally within adjacency with the least troops for 2 round(s).

At 6+ Stars: Increase the Physical Damage dealt to +45% and the Tactical Damage dealt to +90%. Increase the chance to apply Protect to 50%. Additionally, when you apply Protect, reduce your Physical and Fire Damage Received by -10% for 2 round(s).

structured.protect_target: 1 other Ally within adjacency with the least troops

vanguard.name: Champion's Brilliance
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Strength, Intelligence, and Instinct by +15. Reduce Damage Received by -8% of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

habits.name: Noble Sacrifice
habits.verbatim: Start of Round 1: Increase your Tactical Damage Received by 0% for 5 round(s). Additionally, reduce the Physical Damage Dealt of 1 Enemy in any lane (prioritizing Warriors) and the Fire Damage Dealt of 1 Enemy in any lane (prioritizing Hunters). Each effect reduces Damage Dealt by -15% and lasts for 5 round(s).

habits.name: Nimble Resilience
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce your Damage Received by -12% and increase your Initiative by +24% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Bronze Bulwark
verbatim: Bronze Fury gains: Increase the amount of Physical Damage dealt to +45% and the Tactical Damage dealt to +90%.
Increase the chance to apply Protect to 50%. Additionally, when you apply Protect, reduce your Physical and Fire Damage Received by -10% for 2 round(s).
Protect causes damage dealt to the target by Commands and Habits to be split between them and the dragon that applied Protect.

habits.name: Fury's Poise
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: For each Warrior in the enemy army, reduce your Physical Damage Received by -9%. For each Hunter in the enemy army, reduce your Fire Damage Received by -9%. Each effect lasts until the end of combat.

habits.name: Vengeful Fury
habits.verbatim: Each Round: If you are below 50% Max Troop Capacity, deal Physical Damage (Damage Rate: +60%) to the enemy with the lowest Instinct and deal Tactical Damage (Damage Rate: +100%) to the enemy with the lowest Intelligence. This effect only triggers once per combat.

notes: At 6 Stars and Bronze Bulwark Level 5, Bronze Fury reaches 45% Physical and 90% Tactical damage rates with a 50% Protect chance.
Noble Sacrifice trades early Tactical vulnerability for targeted Physical and Fire suppression; the vulnerability falls to 0% at Habit Level 5.
Champion's Brilliance supports the Right Flank only when Vermithor occupies Vanguard, so lane placement should be compared against the other two Vanguard abilities rather than assumed.
